content_fields.title: Test strength of password reset mechanism
content_fields.description: Harden the reset flow: limit verification attempts, rate-limit the endpoint and compare the code in constant time.
content_fields.finding: The reset code is compared with no attempt limit and no rate limiting, so the four-digit code is brute-forceable within its fifteen-minute window.
criteria: The code is invalidated after a bounded number of failed attempts.
The endpoint is rate-limited per account and per source.
Comparison is constant time and error messages do not distinguish failure causes.
